needs: The trustees of the Sithole Family Trust wish to invest USD 1.2 million offshore in a pure global equity mandate with no local exposure. No income is required; all returns are reinvested for the benefit of the next generation. The trust has an aggressive risk appetite and a horizon of ten years or more.

objective.riskProfile: Aggressive. The trust seeks maximum long-term capital growth and is comfortable with significant short-term volatility given its ten-year-plus horizon and reinvestment of all returns.

replacements.details: This proposal replaces an existing offshore unit-trust portfolio that the trust is unwinding.
